fullText.simplified:
相爱的心

    树上又长了很多小小的绿叶，在阳光中落下影子。桥边开着大朵大朵的花，叫蝴蝶都不愿意离开。
    春天是真的到了。
    比春天更美的，是两颗相爱的心。
    温姬每隔两三天，就会来周明家一次。只要他们在一起，时间就会变得很快，不知不觉间天就亮了。
    温姬实在是一个很好的女孩。她对什么都充满新奇，像一只快乐的小鸟。她常常问周明以前在学校的经历，一说到上学就两眼放光。她还很爱看书，很有才华。她有时会向周明借走一些书，下次再还回来。她这样爱看书，连周明都觉得自己不如她。
    很明显，温姬非常喜欢周明，也从不为此感到羞愧。她会和周明说说自己从书里看到的故事，两个人一起哈哈大笑。她也会在早起的时候，给爱人留下一份热包子，或是弯腰留下一个亲吻再走。
    偶尔几天不能来见周明，温姬就会给他写一封信，或是画一幅画，请人送到他家。周明只要看到那幅画里的自己，就能明白温姬的爱意。
    周明呢，也很喜欢和温姬在一起。他会和温姬一起下棋和聊天，直到半夜也能听到他们俩人的笑声。他去书店买书，回来的路上看到一朵漂亮的花，也会忽然想到温姬，然后伸手挑一朵送给她。
    为了保护温姬，周明从不问起她的“工作”，也从不对任何人说起她。这种不为人知的、小小的快乐让他们都沉迷不已。
    这个陌生的城市对于周明来说，也不再陌生，而是充满了美好。他不再为考试结果而担心和紧张，而是每天都在期待温姬的到来。
    有时候，周明也希望温姬能在白天的时候出现，但温姬总是告诉他：“不行，白天我不能出门……太阳会晒伤我的。”
    周明虽然觉得有些奇怪，但也不再多问了。
fullText.traditional:
相愛的心

    樹上又長了很多小小的綠葉，在陽光中落下影子。橋邊開著大朵大朵的花，叫蝴蝶都不願意離開。
    春天是真的到了。
    比春天更美的，是兩顆相愛的心。
    溫姬每隔兩三天，就會來周明家一次。只要他們在一起，時間就會變得很快，不知不覺間天就亮了。
    溫姬實在是一個很好的女孩。她對什麼都充滿新奇，像一隻快樂的小鳥。她常常問周明以前在學校的經歷，一說到上學就兩眼放光。她還很愛看書，很有才華。她有時會向周明借走一些書，下次再還回來。她這樣愛看書，連周明都覺得自己不如她。
    很明顯，溫姬非常喜歡周明，也從不為此感到羞愧。她會和周明說說自己從書裡看到的故事，兩個人一起哈哈大笑。她也會在早起的時候，給愛人留下一份熱包子，或是彎腰留下一個親吻再走。
    偶爾幾天不能來見周明，溫姬就會給他寫一封信，或是畫一幅畫，請人送到他家。周明只要看到那幅畫裡的自己，就能明白溫姬的愛意。
    周明呢，也很喜歡和溫姬在一起。他會和溫姬一起下棋和聊天，直到半夜也能聽到他們倆人的笑聲。他去書店買書，回來的路上看到一朵漂亮的花，也會忽然想到溫姬，然後伸手挑一朵送給她。
    為了保護溫姬，周明從不問起她的“工作”，也從不對任何人說起她。這種不為人知的、小小的快樂讓他們都沉迷不已。
    這個陌生的城市對於周明來說，也不再陌生，而是充滿了美好。他不再為考試結果而擔心和緊張，而是每天都在期待溫姬的到來。
    有時候，周明也希望溫姬能在白天的時候出現，但溫姬總是告訴他：“不行，白天我不能出門……太陽會曬傷我的。”
    周明雖然覺得有些奇怪，但也不再多問了。

sentences.traditional: 橋邊開著大朵大朵的花，叫蝴蝶都不願意離開。

sentences.english: There were huge flowers blooming by the bridge, making the butterflies reluctant to leave.

sentences.simplified: 春天是真的到了。
sentences.traditional: 春天是真的到了。
sentences.pinyin: chūn tiān shì zhēn de dào le
sentences.english: Spring was really here.

sentences.simplified: 比春天更美的，是两颗相爱的心。
sentences.traditional: 比春天更美的，是兩顆相愛的心。
sentences.pinyin: bǐ chūn tiān gèng měi de shì liǎng kē xiāng ài de xīn
sentences.english: Two hearts in love are even more beautiful than spring.

sentences.simplified: 温姬每隔两三天，就会来周明家一次。
sentences.traditional: 溫姬每隔兩三天，就會來周明家一次。
sentences.pinyin: wēn jī měi gé liǎng sān tiān jiù huì lái zhōu míng jiā yí cì
sentences.english: Wen Ji would come to Zhou Ming’s house once every two or three days.

sentences.simplified: 只要他们在一起，时间就会变得很快，不知不觉间天就亮了。
sentences.traditional: 只要他們在一起，時間就會變得很快，不知不覺間天就亮了。
sentences.pinyin: zhǐ yào tā men zài yì qǐ shí jiān jiù huì biàn de hěn kuài bù zhī bù jué jiān tiān jiù liàng le
sentences.english: As long as they were together, time would pass very quickly, and dawn would arrive before they knew it.

sentences.simplified: 温姬实在是一个很好的女孩。她对什么都充满新奇，像一只快乐的小鸟。
sentences.traditional: 溫姬實在是一個很好的女孩。她對什麼都充滿新奇，像一隻快樂的小鳥。
sentences.pinyin: wēn jī shí zài shì yí ge hěn hǎo de nǚ hái tā duì shén me dōu chōng mǎn xīn qí xiàng yì zhī kuài lè de xiǎo niǎo
sentences.english: Wen Ji really was a very good girl. She was full of novelty about everything, like a happy bird.

sentences.simplified: 她常常问周明以前在学校的经历，
sentences.traditional: 她常常問周明以前在學校的經歷，
sentences.pinyin: tā cháng cháng wèn zhōu míng yǐ qián zài xué xiào de jīng lì
sentences.english: She often asked Zhou Ming about his previous school experiences, ..

sentences.simplified: 一说到上学就两眼放光。
sentences.traditional: 一說到上學就兩眼放光。
sentences.pinyin: yì shuō dào shàng xué jiù liǎng yǎn fàng guāng
sentences.english: .. and her eyes lit up when going to school was mentioned.

sentences.simplified: 她还很爱看书，很有才华。
sentences.traditional: 她還很愛看書，很有才華。
sentences.pinyin: tā hái hěn ài kàn shū hěn yǒu cái huá
sentences.english: She also loved reading and was very talented.

sentences.simplified: 她有时会向周明借走一些书，下次再还回来。
sentences.traditional: 她有時會向周明借走一些書，下次再還回來。
sentences.pinyin: tā yǒu shí huì xiàng zhōu míng jiè zǒu yì xiē shū xià cì zài huán huí lai
sentences.english: Sometimes she would borrow some books from Zhou Ming and return them the next time.

sentences.simplified: 她这样爱看书，连周明都觉得自己不如她。
sentences.traditional: 她這樣愛看書，連周明都覺得自己不如她。
sentences.pinyin: tā zhè yàng ài kàn shū lián zhōu míng dōu jué de zì jǐ bù rú tā
sentences.english: She loved reading so much. Even Zhou Ming felt that he was inferior to her.

sentences.simplified: 很明显，温姬非常喜欢周明，也从不为此感到羞愧。
sentences.traditional: 很明顯，溫姬非常喜歡周明，也從不為此感到羞愧。
sentences.pinyin: hěn míng xiǎn wēn jī fēi cháng xǐ huan zhōu míng yě cóng bú wèi cǐ gǎn dào xiū kuì
sentences.english: Obviously, Wen Ji liked Zhou Ming very much and never felt ashamed of it.

sentences.simplified: 她会和周明说说自己从书里看到的故事，两个人一起哈哈大笑。
sentences.traditional: 她會和周明說說自己從書裡看到的故事，兩個人一起哈哈大笑。
sentences.pinyin: tā huì hé zhōu míng shuō shuo zì jǐ cóng shū lǐ kàn dào de gù shi liǎng ge rén yì qǐ hā hā dà xiào
sentences.english: She would tell Zhou Ming about the stories she read in books, and the two of them would burst out laughing together.

sentences.simplified: 她也会在早起的时候，给爱人留下一份热包子，
sentences.traditional: 她也會在早起的時候，給愛人留下一份熱包子，
sentences.pinyin: tā yě huì zài zǎo qǐ de shí hou gěi ài ren liú xià yí fèn rè bāo zi
sentences.english: When she woke up early, she would leave a portion of hot steamed buns for her lover, ..

sentences.simplified: 或是弯腰留下一个亲吻再走。
sentences.traditional: 或是彎腰留下一個親吻再走。
sentences.pinyin: huò shì wān yāo liú xià yí ge qīn wěn zài zǒu
sentences.english: .. or bend down and give him a kiss before leaving.

sentences.simplified: 偶尔几天不能来见周明，
sentences.traditional: 偶爾幾天不能來見周明，
sentences.pinyin: ǒu ěr jǐ tiān bù néng lái jiàn zhōu míng
sentences.english: Occasionally, if she couldn’t come to see Zhou Ming for a few days, ..

sentences.simplified: 温姬就会给他写一封信，或是画一幅画，请人送到他家。
sentences.traditional: 溫姬就會給他寫一封信，或是畫一幅畫，請人送到他家。
sentences.pinyin: wēn jī jiù huì gěi tā xiě yì fēng xìn huò shì huà yì fú huà qǐng rén sòng dào tā jiā
sentences.english: .. Wen Ji would write him a letter or paint a picture, and ask someone to send it to his home.

sentences.simplified: 周明只要看到那幅画里的自己，就能明白温姬的爱意。
sentences.traditional: 周明只要看到那幅畫裡的自己，就能明白溫姬的愛意。
sentences.pinyin: zhōu míng zhǐ yào kàn dào nà fú huà lǐ de zì jǐ jiù néng míng bai wēn jī de ài yì
sentences.english: Zhou Ming only had to see himself in that painting to understand Wen Ji’s love.

sentences.simplified: 周明呢，也很喜欢和温姬在一起。
sentences.traditional: 周明呢，也很喜歡和溫姬在一起。
sentences.pinyin: zhōu míng ne yě hěn xǐ huan hé wēn jī zài yì qǐ
sentences.english: Zhou Ming also liked to be with Wen Ji very much.

sentences.simplified: 他会和温姬一起下棋和聊天，直到半夜也能听到他们俩人的笑声。
sentences.traditional: 他會和溫姬一起下棋和聊天，直到半夜也能聽到他們倆人的笑聲。
sentences.pinyin: tā huì hé wēn jī yì qǐ xià qí hé liáo tiān zhí dào bàn yè yě néng tīng dào tā men liǎ rén de xiào shēng
sentences.english: He would play chess and chat with Wen Ji, and you could hear the laughter of both of them far into the night.

sentences.simplified: 他去书店买书，回来的路上看到一朵漂亮的花，
sentences.traditional: 他去書店買書，回來的路上看到一朵漂亮的花，
sentences.pinyin: tā qù shū diàn mǎi shū huí lái de lù shang kàn dào yì duǒ piào liang de huā
sentences.english: He went to the bookstore to buy books, and when he saw a beautiful flower on the way back, ..

sentences.simplified: 也会忽然想到温姬，然后伸手挑一朵送给她。
sentences.traditional: 也會忽然想到溫姬，然後伸手挑一朵送給她。
sentences.pinyin: yě huì hū rán xiǎng dào wēn jī rán hòu shēn shǒu tiāo yì duǒ sòng gěi tā
sentences.english: .. he would suddenly think of Wen Ji, then reach out and pick one for her.

sentences.simplified: 为了保护温姬，周明从不问起她的“工作”，也从不对任何人说起她。
sentences.traditional: 為了保護溫姬，周明從不問起她的“工作”，也從不對任何人說起她。
sentences.pinyin: wèi le bǎo hù wēn jī zhōu míng cóng bú wèn qǐ tā de gōng zuò yě cóng bú duì rèn hé rén shuō qǐ tā
sentences.english: In order to protect Wen Ji, Zhou Ming never asked about her “job”, nor did he tell anyone about her.

sentences.simplified: 这种不为人知的、小小的快乐让他们都沉迷不已。
sentences.traditional: 這種不為人知的、小小的快樂讓他們都沉迷不已。
sentences.pinyin: zhè zhǒng bù wéi rén zhī de xiǎo xiǎo de kuài lè ràng tā men dōu chén mí bù yǐ
sentences.english: This tiny happiness that no one knew about made them both addicted.

sentences.simplified: 这个陌生的城市对于周明来说，也不再陌生，而是充满了美好。
sentences.traditional: 這個陌生的城市對於周明來說，也不再陌生，而是充滿了美好。
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge mò shēng de chéng shì duì yú zhōu míng lái shuō yě bú zài mò shēng ér shì chōng mǎn le měi hǎo
sentences.english: This strange city was no longer strange to Zhou Ming. Instead, it was full of beauty.

sentences.simplified: 他不再为考试结果而担心和紧张，而是每天都在期待温姬的到来。
sentences.traditional: 他不再為考試結果而擔心和緊張，而是每天都在期待溫姬的到來。
sentences.pinyin: tā bú zài wèi kǎo shì jié guǒ ér dān xīn hé jǐn zhāng ér shì měi tiān dōu zài qī dài wēn jī de dào lái
sentences.english: He was no longer worried and nervous about exam results. Instead, he looked forward to Wen Ji’s arrival every day.

sentences.simplified: 有时候，周明也希望温姬能在白天的时候出现，但温姬总是告诉他：
sentences.traditional: 有時候，周明也希望溫姬能在白天的時候出現，但溫姬總是告訴他：

sentences.english: Sometimes, Zhou Ming also hoped that Wen Ji would show up during the day, but Wen Ji always told him, ..

sentences.simplified: “不行，白天我不能出门……太阳会晒伤我的。”
sentences.traditional: “不行，白天我不能出門……太陽會曬傷我的。”
sentences.pinyin: bù xíng bái tiān wǒ bù néng chū mén tài yáng huì shài shāng wǒ de
sentences.english: .. “No, I can’t go out during the day … The sun will burn me.”

sentences.simplified: 周明虽然觉得有些奇怪，但也不再多问了。
sentences.traditional: 周明雖然覺得有些奇怪，但也不再多問了。
sentences.pinyin: zhōu míng suī rán jué de yǒu xiē qí guài dàn yě bú zài duō wèn le
sentences.english: Although Zhou Ming thought that it was a little strange, he didn’t ask anymore.

sentence_translations: Hearts in Love
Many small green leaves grew on the trees, casting shadows in the sunlight.
There were huge flowers blooming by the bridge, making the butterflies reluctant to leave.
Spring was really here.
Two hearts in love are even more beautiful than spring.
Wen Ji would come to Zhou Ming’s house once every two or three days.
As long as they were together, time would pass very quickly, and dawn would arrive before they knew it.
Wen Ji really was a very good girl. She was full of novelty about everything, like a happy bird.
She often asked Zhou Ming about his previous school experiences, ..
.. and her eyes lit up when going to school was mentioned.
She also loved reading and was very talented.
Sometimes she would borrow some books from Zhou Ming and return them the next time.
She loved reading so much. Even Zhou Ming felt that he was inferior to her.
Obviously, Wen Ji liked Zhou Ming very much and never felt ashamed of it.
She would tell Zhou Ming about the stories she read in books, and the two of them would burst out laughing together.
When she woke up early, she would leave a portion of hot steamed buns for her lover, ..
.. or bend down and give him a kiss before leaving.
Occasionally, if she couldn’t come to see Zhou Ming for a few days, ..
.. Wen Ji would write him a letter or paint a picture, and ask someone to send it to his home.
Zhou Ming only had to see himself in that painting to understand Wen Ji’s love.
Zhou Ming also liked to be with Wen Ji very much.
He would play chess and chat with Wen Ji, and you could hear the laughter of both of them far into the night.
He went to the bookstore to buy books, and when he saw a beautiful flower on the way back, ..
.. he would suddenly think of Wen Ji, then reach out and pick one for her.
In order to protect Wen Ji, Zhou Ming never asked about her “job”, nor did he tell anyone about her.
This tiny happiness that no one knew about made them both addicted.
This strange city was no longer strange to Zhou Ming. Instead, it was full of beauty.
He was no longer worried and nervous about exam results. Instead, he looked forward to Wen Ji’s arrival every day.
Sometimes, Zhou Ming also hoped that Wen Ji would show up during the day, but Wen Ji always told him, ..
.. “No, I can’t go out during the day … The sun will burn me.”
Although Zhou Ming thought that it was a little strange, he didn’t ask anymore.
